description: This file defines the NationalityAPI class, which provides CRUD API endpoints for managing nationalities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for fetching, creating, updating, and deleting nationality records, with validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: NationalityAPI
classes.description: A RESTful API endpoint class for managing Nationality entities, supporting CRUD operations such as get, create, update, and delete. Implements validation, documentation annotations, and integrates with the NationalityService.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches a single Nationality record by ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Nationality records with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: saveNationality
methods.description: Helper function to set Nationality name from request and save it via the service.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Nationality record identified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple Nationality records by IDs.
